svg.aria-label: The capstone pipeline: an ingest worker reads at-least-once payment deliveries from a Redis stream, skips duplicates with Redis dedup keys and writes them to Cassandra (payment events by day and per-day counters). MongoDB holds applications and syncs an identity graph to Neo4j. extract.py copies Cassandra by day partition with a lookback, MongoDB by updated_at watermark plus a key scan for deletes, and Neo4j as snapshots into a raw Parquet lake. model.py builds the DuckDB model and the fct_loan and mart_delinquency marts, and reconcile.py compares counts and checksums with each source.

svg.text: Four operational systems of a fictional lender, copied into a Parquet lake, modelled in DuckDB and reconciled.
